## Gender

Canonical values (from the Node config module): `Male`, `Female`

**`name`**

| Fields | What differs |
|---|---|
| `Team.sex` | the field is called `sex`, not `gender` |

Proposed: Java field is always `gender`; `TeamDocument` maps it with `@Field("sex")` (08 §3). Stored name unchanged.

## AgeGroup

Canonical values (from the Node config module): `Under10`, `Under12`, `Under14`, `Under16`, `Under18`, `Above16`, `Above18`, `AllAges`

**`subset`**

| Fields | What differs |
|---|---|
| `Competition.registeredTeams[].players[].ageGroup`<br>`Competition.ageGroups[].ageGroup`<br>`Player.ageGroup`<br>`Player.lockedAgeGroup`<br>`Qualification.qualifiers[].sourceAgeGroup`<br>`Qualification.tied[].sourceAgeGroup`<br>`Qualification.skipped[].sourceAgeGroup`<br>`Qualification.slices[].ageGroup`<br>`Qualification.drawOrders[].ageGroup`<br>`Team.teamAgeGroup`<br>`WalkInRegistration.rows[].writtenAgeGroup`<br>`WalkInRegistration.rows[].ageGroup` | doesn't allow `AllAges` (= named set `ENTRY`) |

Proposed: One enum. `AgeGroup.ENTRY` (athletes, teams, entries) and `AgeGroup.CATEGORY` (panels, score sheets, order, draws) are named sets on it; each document field is validated against the set Node uses (08 §3). Age ranges move to the rulebook (09), not the enum.

## CompetitionType

Canonical values (from the Node config module): `competition_1`, `competition_2`, `competition_3`

**`subset`**

| Fields | What differs |
|---|---|
| `Qualification.competitionType` | doesn't allow `competition_1` |

Proposed: `Qualification.competitionType` keeps Node's restriction as a named set `CompetitionType.FINALS` (Competition II and III).

**`form`**

| Fields | What differs |
|---|---|
| `Score.competitionType` | stores the display form (`Competition I`, `Competition II`, `Competition III`) instead of the wire value |

Proposed: One enum; slug is the wire value. `scores.competitionType` is declared `DisplayForm<CompetitionType>` and its converter writes `display()` and reads with `fromAny` (08 §4).

## Role

Canonical values (from the Node config module): `player`, `coach`, `judge`, `admin`, `superadmin`

**`subset`**

| Fields | What differs |
|---|---|
| `AccountRequest.userType` | doesn't allow `superadmin` |
| `AccountRequest.decidedBy.userType` | doesn't allow `player`, `judge`, `admin` |
| `Admin.role` | doesn't allow `player`, `coach`, `judge` |
| `AuditLog.adminType` | doesn't allow `judge` |

Proposed: One `Role` enum. Each field keeps Node's allowed list as a named set (`Role.ACCOUNT_REQUESTERS`, `Role.ADMIN_ROLES`, `Role.AUDITED`, `Role.REQUEST_DECIDERS`), so a value Node would refuse is still refused (08 §1).

## EmailType

Canonical values (union of the fields): `self`, `guardian`, `none`

**`subset`**

| Fields | What differs |
|---|---|
| `AccountRequest.newEmailType` | doesn't allow `none` |

Proposed: `AccountRequest.newEmailType` keeps Node's restriction as a named set `EmailType.CHANGEABLE_TO` (a change request can't move to `none`).
